# Delivery qualification

Staging is private, uses synthetic data, and has no shared services or production credentials. The delivery owner has approved build plus passing smoke as its staging gate. Compatibility may finish concurrently with staging. Production still requires green smoke, green compatibility, and ready staging for the same artifact from this workflow run, followed by its existing environment approval. Missing or failed compatibility must prevent production. The delivery owner reviews every staging and production qualification failure in the run. No change to runners, approval, or permissions is approved.
